question: Which space agency launched a first-of-its-kind mission named DART?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NASA **__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NASA's**____** Double Asteroid Redirection Test (DART)**,__ the world's first full-scale mission to test technology for defending Earth against potential asteroid or comet hazards.
 
• Launched from Space Launch Complex 4 East at **Vandenberg Space Force Base in California.**
 
• DART is **the first-ever mission dedicated to investigating and demonstrating one method of asteroid deflection by changing an asteroid's motion in space through kinetic impact**. 
 
• **DART** is a joint project between** NASA and the Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory (APL). **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Headquater of Roscosmos** - Moscow.**
 
• Its launch facilities include **Baikonur Cosmodrome ****in Kazakhstan**, the world's first and largest spaceport, and **Vtochny Cosmodrome,** which is being built in the Russian Far East in Amur Oblast.
 
• The launch of **Chandrayaan-3** is planned for** August 2022.**
 
• **On July 22, 2019, Chandrayaan-2's rocket successfully lifted off with the Vikram Lander and Pragyan rover** housed in it.
 
• **ISRO built India's first satellite,** **Aryabhata**, which was launched by the **Soviet Union in 1975.**
 
• **JAXA__ **
 
• JAXA was formed on** 1 October 2003**.
 
• It is responsible for research, technology development, and the launch of a satellite into orbit and is involved in many more advanced missions such as **asteroid exploration** and possible** human exploration of the moon**.
